provenance_quote: PrtA, a repeats-in-toxin (RTX) alkaline zinc metalloprotease produced by the bacterial symbiont Photorhabdus ... is transported via an ABC transporter system (PrtBCD)
notes: UniProt Q84F70 live = Serralysin / prtA1, Photorhabdus luminescens, subcellular location Secreted/extracellular; matches gene+organism. DOI 10.1099/mic.0.26171-0 resolves (Bowen et al. 2003, Microbiology, 'Genetic and biochemical characterization of PrtA, an RTX-like metalloprotease from Photorhabdus'); describes PrtA secreted by ABC transporter PrtBCD = T1SS substrate. RTX metalloprotease via Prt/ABC exporter is a canonical T1SS substrate. Provenance quote drawn from the resolved Crossref/article record.

provenance_quote: Proteases B and C are synthesized and secreted as zymogens without a signal peptide.
notes: UniProt P16316 live = Serralysin B / Secreted protease B / prtB, Dickeya (Erwinia) chrysanthemi; Secreted, no signal peptide, hemolysin-type Ca repeats = T1SS RTX-like substrate. DOI 10.1016/S0021-9258(18)81905-6 resolves (Delepelaire & Wandersman 1989 JBC 'Protease Secretion by Erwinia chrysanthemi', PMID 2722818). UniProt cites same paper. Signal-peptide-less serralysin secreted by Prt ABC exporter = T1SS.

provenance_quote: Lipase secretion by bacterial hybrid ATP-binding cassette exporters: molecular recognition of the LipBCD, PrtDEF, and HasDEF exporters
notes: UniProt P16317 live = Serralysin C / Secreted protease C / prtC, Dickeya (Erwinia) chrysanthemi; Secreted, C-terminal secretion signal analogous to E. coli alpha-hemolysin, no signal peptide = classic T1SS substrate. DOI 10.1128/jb.179.15.4754-4760.1997 resolves (Akatsuka et al. 1997 J Bacteriol); examines E. chrysanthemi PrtDEF ABC exporter secreting PrtC/LipA/HasA = T1SS. Quote is article title from resolved record; secretion claim supported.

provenance_quote: Identification and Characterization of an RTX Toxin in the Emerging Pathogen Kingella kingae
notes: UniProt A1YKW7 live = Cytolysin RtxA / rtxA, Kingella kingae; Secreted RTX prokaryotic toxin (TC 1.C.11), key virulence cytotoxin. DOI 10.1128/JB.01319-06 resolves (Kehl-Fie & St. Geme 2007 J Bacteriol); identifies the RTX toxin locus (toxin + secretion apparatus) whose disruption abolishes cytotoxicity. RTX toxins are canonical T1SS substrates secreted by their cognate ABC/HlyBD-type exporter. Quote is article title from resolved record.
